Our Fiscal 2026 NEOs were: Jen-Hsun Huang, President and CEO; Colette M. Kress, EVP and CFO; Ajay K. Puri, EVP, Worldwide Field Operations; Debora Shoquist, EVP, Operations; and Timothy S. Teter, EVP, General Counsel and Secretary. Fiscal 2026 Executive Compensation Summary Continued Focus on Pay for Performance NVIDIA’s executive compensation program in Fiscal 2026 continued to be guided by a pay for performance philosophy to link competitive NEO pay with our stockholders’ interests. 96% of our CEO’s and 48% of our other NEOs’ Fiscal 2026 total target pay was dependent on corporate performance.
